data.name: Online Retail
data.abstract: This is a transactional data set which contains all the transactions occurring between 01/12/2010 and 09/12/2011 for a UK-based and registered non-store online retail.

intro_paper.title: Data mining for the online retail industry: A case study of RFM model-based customer segmentation using data mining
intro_paper.authors: Daqing Chen, Sai Laing Sain, Kun Guo
intro_paper.venue: Journal of Database Marketing and Customer Strategy Management, Vol. 19, No. 3

variables.name: InvoiceNo
variables.description: a 6-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each transaction. If this code starts with letter 'c', it indicates a cancellation

variables.name: StockCode
variables.description: a 5-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each distinct product

variables.name: Quantity
variables.description: the quantities of each product (item) per transaction

variables.name: InvoiceDate
variables.description: the day and time when each transaction was generated

variables.name: CustomerID
variables.description: a 5-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each customer

variables.name: Country
variables.description: the name of the country where each customer resides

additional_info.summary: This is a transactional data set which contains all the transactions occurring between 01/12/2010 and 09/12/2011 for a UK-based and registered non-store online retail.The company mainly sells unique all-occasion gifts. Many customers of the company are wholesalers.
additional_info.variable_info:
InvoiceNo: Invoice number. Nominal, a 6-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each transaction. If this code starts with letter 'c', it indicates a cancellation. 
StockCode: Product (item) code. Nominal, a 5-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each distinct product.
Description: Product (item) name. Nominal.
Quantity: The quantities of each product (item) per transaction. Numeric.	
InvoiceDate: Invoice Date and time. Numeric, the day and time when each transaction was generated.
UnitPrice: Unit price. Numeric, Product price per unit in sterling.
CustomerID: Customer number. Nominal, a 5-digit integral number uniquely assigned to each customer.
Country: Country name. Nominal, the name of the country where each customer resides.
